source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At the start of each battle round you may choose one of the two imperatives below; until that round ends it applies to your army, and every unit of yours with this ability gains its effects. PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE: the unit's ranged weapons gain [HEAVY] and their Ballistic Skill improves by 1; while the unit is BATTLELINE itself or has another ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE unit of yours no more than 6" away, melee attacks aimed at it subtract 1 from their Hit rolls. CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE: its ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and the Weapon Skill of its melee weapons improves by 1; under that same BATTLELINE condition, each attack its models make has its Armour Penetration improved by 1.
